name: substitute-all-til [^X-s]
desc: perform an all-occurrence text substitution over the region

name: trim-lines-til, trim [^A-t]
desc: trim trailing whitespace from lines in the region

name: blank-region, blank [^A-b]
desc: replace the region with whitespace

name: yank-til [y]

name: yank-lines-til, y [^X-y]
desc: get lines covered by region into given named or unnamed register

name: substitute-again-til, & [^A-&]
desc: redo the previous text substitution over the region

name: transfer-til, t
desc: copy text in the region

desc: write attributed text from region to file. whole buffer by default

name: overwrite-chars [R]

name: overwrite-string

name: overwrite-number
desc: replace text at the cursor by the given character-number

name: perl

name: position-window [z]
desc: reframe with cursor at center (.,M,m), top (CR,H,t), or bottom (-,L,b)

desc: switch to previous buffer (or the most-recently-visited, if \"autobuffer\" on

desc: implements bash's pushd semantics (i.e., cd \"dir\", push \"dir\" on dirstack)

desc: insert CNT copies of (un)named register, before cursor

name: quote-next-character

name: remove-submode

name: remove-scheme

name: redraw-display

desc: replace CNT characters at the cursor with the given character

name: restore-window
desc: return to window saved with \"save-window\"

name: reverse-char-scan [,]

desc: search for previous pattern in opposite direction from before

name: reset-char-classes

name: set-terminal

name: list-undo-stack, show-undo-stack

name: position [^G ^X-=]

name: show-system-variables, list-$variables, list-system-variables

name: list-user-variables, show-user-variables

name: version
desc: report version information for the editor

name: marks, list-marks, show-marks

name: memory
desc: report on available memory

name: tags, tagstack, list-tagstack, show-tagstack
desc: show the stack of successive tag references

name: shrink-window [v]

name: exsource
desc: source a file of ex commands

name: shell-command
desc: run a shell command

name: function-prefix [#]
desc: prefix used to represent commands normally bound to function keys

desc: split the window in half; CNT of 1 or 2 chooses which becomes current

name: store-macro

name: store-procedure

name: store-operator

name: substitute-again [&]

desc: synchronize the current buffer's file in DevStudio's editor

name: swap-clipboard-keys
desc: swap clipboard insert key mappings

name: unbind-cmdmode-key

name: unbind-selmode-key
